2607.04890.title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Antisemitic Incident Classification
2607.04890.paper_summary: Addressing hate and violence in society requires timely detection of hateful events from public reporting, but automated identification of hateful events remains underexplored. We introduce the task of hateful event detection and investigate the ability of AI systems, specifically large language models (LLMs), to discover and classify reports of antisemitic events with fine-grained labels. We evaluate OpenAI's GPT-4o and Meta's Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct on multiple expert-annotated datasets containing antisemitic event descriptions from news articles, civil society reports, and official records. We show that LLMs, particularly GPT-4o, have potential for this task, but substantial improvement is needed. Providing clear term definitions and in-context examples in prompts can improve performance: definitions are most helpful for rhetoric-oriented events (e.g. classical antisemitic tropes), while examples help label action-oriented events (e.g. physical assault). A case study of college newspapers demonstrates that LLMs can help surface relevant real-world events, supporting early monitoring and intervention. Overall, our findings highlight both opportunities and critical gaps in AI's ability to recognize complex harms and underscore the need for collaborative efforts among AI developers, policymakers, and civil society to design models, implement robust evaluation, and develop policy frameworks for defining and combating hate efficiently and effectively.
2607.04890.paper_summary_zh: 處理社會中的仇恨和暴力需要及時檢測來自公眾報告的仇恨事件，但自動識別仇恨事件仍然未被充分探索。<lb/>我們引入了仇恨事件檢測的任務，並調查人工智慧系統，特別是大型語言模型（LLMs），發現和分類反猶太事件報告的能力，並使用細緻的標籤。<lb/>我們在多個專家標註的數據集上評估了OpenAI的GPT-4o和Meta的Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct，這些數據集包含來自新聞文章、公民社會報告和官方記錄的反猶太事件描述。<lb/>我們顯示LLMs，特別是GPT-4o，在這項任務上具有潛力，但仍需大幅改進。<lb/>在提示中提供明確的術語定義和上下文示例可以改善性能：對於以修辭為導向的事件（例如，經典的反猶太主義比喻），定義最為有用，而示例則有助於標記以行動為導向的事件（例如，身體攻擊）。<lb/>一項關於大學報紙的案例研究表明，LLMs可以幫助揭示相關的現實世界事件，支持早期監測和干預。<lb/>總體而言，我們的研究結果突顯了人工智慧在識別複雜傷害方面的機會和關鍵缺口，並強調了人工智慧開發者、政策制定者和公民社會之間合作的必要性，以設計模型、實施穩健的評估，並制定政策框架，以有效和高效地定義和對抗仇恨。
